title: Johnson-Cook flow stress + adiabatic temperature evolution
objective: Add a Johnson-Cook viscoplastic model with the full flow stress (A, B, n, C, m, Tmelt, Tref) and adiabatic temperature evolution from plastic dissipation (dT = beta sigma : D_p / (rho c_p)).
scope: Add `mechdsl.symbolic.models.johnson_cook` with `JohnsonCookMaterial` dataclass holding all 8 parameters (A, B, n, C, m, eps_dot_0, T_melt, T_ref) plus `rho_c_p` and Taylor-Quinney coefficient beta (default 0.9).
Extend the return map with coupled (dl, dT) Newton iteration: the yield stress depends on (alpha, T) and T depends on alpha via plastic-dissipation heating.
Unit-test at T = Tref and eps_dot = eps_dot_0: Johnson-Cook reduces to a power-law-hardening plasticity, comparable to j2_power_law with matched parameters.
implementation_steps: Implement `radial_return` with the coupled (dl, dT) solve.
Unit-test thermal softening (increasing T lowers yield) and rate sensitivity.
Cross-check against a 1D uniaxial closed-form at fixed T and eps_dot.
acceptance_criteria: At T = Tref and eps_dot = eps_dot_0, JC matches a matched-parameter power-law J2 within 1e-8.
Thermal softening: at T > Tref, yield stress is lower than at T = Tref.
Rate hardening: at eps_dot > eps_dot_0, yield stress is higher than at eps_dot_0.
Coupled (dl, dT) Newton converges on all test cases.

cases: Baseline match to power-law J2 at reference state

risks: Near T = Tmelt the material softens catastrophically and the return map can produce nonphysical stresses. Mitigation: clamp T < Tmelt - epsilon with an explicit error message.

commands.command: uv run pytest test_j2 + test_perzyna + test_johnson_cook + test_symbolic_ir_interface + test_frontend_build_context

completion_notes: Module mechdsl/symbolic/models/johnson_cook.py implements JC flow-stress (A + B*alpha^n)*(1 + C*ln(eps_dot_star))*(1 - T_star^m) with rate-floor eps_dot_star = max(dl/(dt*eps_dot_0), 1) and T_star = clip((T-T_ref)/(T_melt-T_ref), 0, 1).
Coupled backward-Euler 2x2 Newton (dl, dT) solved via Cramer's rule with 15-step line-search keeping dl > 0 and T < T_melt - eps.
Adiabatic heating equation rho_c_p * dT = beta * sigma_y(alpha_new, T_new) * dl evaluated implicitly.
T_melt guard raises at entry (T_old >= T_melt) and after Newton (T_new >= T_melt - eps).
Tangent is elastic stub (JC algorithmic tangent deferred to P3-3). TestTaskP3_3JohnsonCookTangent stubs preserved.
